LanguageData.BOR_Gun_Autopistol_TII.label: kwazaari pistol
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_Autopistol_TII.description: A simple semi-automatic pistol mass-produced from a Free-to-Use template which had its patent run out. Vastly superior to conventional firearms in many aspects aside from range and accuracy.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_ChainShotgun_TII.label: kwazaari chain shotgun
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_ChainShotgun_TII.description: A drum-fed fully automatic shotgun which sprays destructive amounts of mildly-heated kwazaari alloy. Originally the weapon came strictly in semi-automatic but was quickly remachined into full automatic after illegally modified versions were confiscated following a ten second police firefight with tax evaders.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_AssaultRifle_TII.label: kwazaari assault rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_AssaultRifle_TII.description: A mass-produced rifle that is resistant to most forms of stress and abuse, while also being cheap to repair. While highly adjustable and customizable many of the parts do not come with the weapon itself, sold as separate overpriced pieces by haggling vendors, thankfully it does come with a variety of holographic flip-up sights and a compensator.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SniperRifle_TII.label: kwazaari sniper rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SniperRifle_TII.description: Little more than a tube of Quasar metal, a bolt, and a stock, The Kwazaari sniper rifle is a by-product of a quite literal cutthroat business environment, where a bad deal can be the difference between a promotion and unmarked shallow grave.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_LMG_TII.label: kwazaari lmg
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_LMG_TII.description:
A box of dangerously strong bullets belt-fed into a hulking behemoth of a weapon, the Kwazaari LMG is capable of suppressing an entire boardroom for the duration of three conference calls or your money back*
*No Refunds, All Sales Final
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_GaussPistol_TII.label: kwazaari gauss pistol bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussPistol_TII.label: kwazaari gauss pistol
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussPistol_TII.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern kwazaari-era warfare. Refined Solarite integration enables electromagnetic acceleration of Sunsteel rounds to devastating effect. The Solar Republics' counter-mechanoid specialists relied on this compact pistol to supplement their arsenal, its superior kickback management allowing sustained fire despite the weapon's formidable power output.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_GaussShotgun_TII.label: kwazaari gauss shotgun blast
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussShotgun_TII.label: kwazaari gauss shotgun
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussShotgun_TII.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern kwazaari-era warfare. A compact electromagnetic shotgun engineered by the Solar Republics for intense close-quarters counter-mechanoid engagements. Solarite reinforcement allows the weapon's frame to withstand the immense recoil forces from its unique fragmented projectile design, making it devastating in the hands of well-trained specialists.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_GaussBattleRifle_TII.label: kwazaari gauss rifle bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussBattleRifle_TII.label: kwazaari gauss rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussBattleRifle_TII.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern kwazaari-era warfare. A versatile electromagnetic rifle utilizing Solar Republics' breakthrough in Solarite-enhanced weapon design. Built specifically for counter-mechanoid operations, the rifle's refined recoil distribution allows even moderately-trained soldiers to maintain accurate sustained fire when facing hostile synthetic threats.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_GaussDMR_TII.label: kwazaari gauss dmr bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussDMR_TII.label: kwazaari gauss dmr
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussDMR_TII.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern kwazaari-era warfare. A designated marksman rifle developed by the Solar Republics for counter-mechanoid specialists. Solarite integration provides exceptional accuracy and stopping power against synthetic targets, while the weapon's recoil compensation system allows sustained rapid fire without degrading accuracy.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_GaussBullpup_TII.label: kwazaari gauss bullpup bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussBullpup_TII.label: kwazaari gauss bullpup
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussBullpup_TII.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern kwazaari-era warfare. A compact yet powerful electromagnetic rifle built for close-quarters counter-mechanoid operations. The Solarite-enhanced frame absorbs the intense recoil forces generated by the gauss accelerator, enabling effective suppressive fire in confined spaces where Solar Republic anti-synthetics teams operate.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_GaussSniperRifle_TII.label: kwazaari gauss sniper rifle bullet
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussSniperRifle_TII.label: kwazaari gauss sniper rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussSniperRifle_TII.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern kwazaari-era warfare. The pinnacle of Solar Republic counter-mechanoid firepower. This precision electromagnetic rifle features Solarite reinforcement throughout its frame to withstand the immense stresses of electromagnetic acceleration. Deployed by elite anti-synthetic specialists, it delivers devastating firepower at extreme range with minimal recoil.
LanguageData.BOR_Bullet_GaussCannon_TII.label: kwazaari gauss cannon shot
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussCannon_TII.label: kwazaari gauss cannon
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_GaussCannon_TII.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern kwazaari-era warfare. A rapid-fire electromagnetic cannon developed by the Solar Republics as the ultimate counter-mechanoid suppressive weapon. Solarite reinforcement allows sustained burst fire without structural degradation, and the weapon's recoil management system enables accurate fire despite its devastating power.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SolarBeamPistol_TII.label: kwazaari less-lethal beam pistol
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SolarBeamPistol_TII.description: A compact kwazaari beam sidearm retuned for less-than-lethal security work. Its sealed electromagnetic emitter delivers a disabling stun, neuralizer, or electromagnetic pulse instead of live ammunition, making it the sidearm of choice for shipboard security and riot suppression aboard vacuum-sealed spacecraft.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SolarBeamBattleRifle_TII.label: kwazaari less-lethal beam rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SolarBeamBattleRifle_TII.descrip: A standard-issue kwazaari beam rifle retuned for less-than-lethal crowd control and detainment operations. Its emitter trades armor-piercing output for a disabling stun, neuralizer, or electromagnetic discharge, incapacitating hostiles without lethal harm.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SolarBeamShotgun_TII.label: kwazaari less-lethal beam scatter
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SolarBeamShotgun_TII.description: A close-quarters kwazaari beam scatter weapon retuned for less-than-lethal riot suppression. Its modified prism fans a stun, neuralizer, or electromagnetic pulse across multiple targets, incapacitating a crowd without lethal casualties.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SolarBeamDMR_TII.label: kwazaari less-lethal beam dmr
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SolarBeamDMR_TII.description: A precision kwazaari beam designated marksman weapon retuned for less-than-lethal takedown operations. Its tight beam focus delivers a disabling stun, neuralizer, or electromagnetic pulse at range, incapacitating a single target without lethal harm.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SolarBeamBullpup_TII.label: kwazaari less-lethal beam bullpup
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SolarBeamBullpup_TII.description: A compact kwazaari beam carbine retuned for less-than-lethal close-quarters detainment. Its bullpup configuration allows rapid follow-up stun, neuralizer, or electromagnetic pulses in confined spaces without risking lethal casualties.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SolarBeamLMG_TII.label: kwazaari less-lethal beam lmg
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SolarBeamLMG_TII.description: A heavy-duty kwazaari beam repeater retuned for less-than-lethal area suppression. Its high-capacity focusing arrays deliver sustained bursts of stun, neuralizer, or electromagnetic pulses, incapacitating hostile crowds without lethal force.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SolarBeamSniperRifle_TII.label: kwazaari less-lethal beam sniper rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SolarBeamSniperRifle_TII.descrip: The most precise less-than-lethal beam weapon in the kwazaari lineup. Its advanced optical focusing array delivers a disabling stun, neuralizer, or electromagnetic pulse at extreme range, incapacitating high-value targets without lethal harm.
